summary.text: Pamela Sanderson is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Sanderson advanced from the Democratic primary for Rockingham 1 on September 10, 2024, alongside incumbent Hal Rafter and Charlotte Fyfe.
In the November 5, 2024 general election she received 15.4 percent of the vote, and Republicans Scott Bryer, James Guzofski and Paul Tudor won the three seats.
